text:
Ana (partnerships): FYI — HW partner pinged for a Q3 private offer. They want committed spend + a HW credit kicker. Need pricing ladder + renewal guardrails.
Mike S (sales): high-level ask? how big a commit?
Ana (partnerships): they mentioned $500k ARR commit in year 1 and want 18mo term. also asked for 10% co-sell credit to SI.
Sophia (HW PM): HW partner expects SKU-flooring (min consumption per month) so their channel can forecast. suggest a 60% floor of committed monthly run-rate.
Oliver (solutions): okay — we should avoid hard floors that break PLG. Can we do a pulse-based floor: e.g., 50% floor first 3 months, step to 75% later?
Priya (finance): need clarity on discount ladder and revenue recognition. running example: commit $500k/year, we can structure as: tiered discount based on annualized usage.
Ana (partnerships): propose discount ladder draft:
```
- $0-$125k: 0% discount
- $125k-$250k: 7% discount
- $250k-$375k: 12% discount
- $375k-$500k+: 18% discount + 5% HW kickback
```
Mike S (sales): 18% at top band seems aggressive vs marketplace baseline. can we make retention accelerator at renewal instead of deep upfront discount?
Sophia (HW PM): HW prefers some up-front to help co-sell. but fine with a smaller renewal uplift: e.g., 5% rebate if they renew at 95%+ of commit.
Oliver (solutions): also request a ramp allowance for months 0-3: credit 20% of commit to allow onboarding, trial. That avoids immediate floor penalties.
Priya (finance): ramp credit OK but must be grossed into commitment schedule and escrowed or deducted from future invoices. prefer escrow for predictability.
Ana (partnerships): @Mike S @Priya can we do private-offer structure: commit locked, escrow holds ramp credit, monthly true-up against actuals, renewal accelerator clause if >=95% utilization?
Mike S (sales): yes if we keep net present value neutral. we'll need SKU mapping to our usage units. call out embeddings vs generation.
Sophia (HW PM): HW credit: 5% of commit paid as co-marketing/training credits to SI, delivered on milestone triggers (first 3 deals closed).
Oliver (solutions): add a safety valve: auto-fallback to public marketplace rates on sustained underrun for 2 consecutive quarters unless a remediation plan is agreed. avoids surprise write-offs.
Priya (finance): can add audit clause + right to true-up. also need to cap write-offs to 10% of commit in year.
Ana (partnerships): action items:
- Mike: map to sales SKU and confirm acceptability of ladder + renewal accelerator (due EOD Tue)
- Priya: draft finance terms for escrow + audit + write-off cap (due Wed)
- Sophia: confirm HW co-marketing credit flow and milestone triggers (due Wed)
- Oliver: draft fallback language for PLG safety valve (due Thu)
Mike S (sales): noted. will ping AMs for SKU mapping.
Priya (finance): will sketch term sheet clause and share redlines.
Sophia (HW PM): will loop in partner ops to validate milestone cadence.
Ana (partnerships): thanks. one more ask — partner wants joint announcement window locked to commit signature + first customer win. ok?
Oliver (solutions): we typically wait for 2-3 customer wins for press, but can do a co-announcement if marketing signs off and SI has a case study.
Ana (partnerships): got it. I'll propose a conditional announce: sign + one customer > $25k ARR or equivalent usage.
Mike S (sales): :thumbsup: sounds reasonable.
deploy-bot: Reminder: please file private-offer record in the marketplace tracker: `#marketplace-private-offers` and attach draft term sheet.
Ana (partnerships): added to tracker and uploaded a starter term sheet in the thread. Will iterate after your redlines.
Priya (finance): quick Q — do we want a hard renewal price protection (hold discount steady) or allow step-down if market moves?
Mike S (sales): prefer protection for 12 months post-term; after that revisit with market clause.
Sophia (HW PM): fine with 12 months.
Ana (partnerships): summary: draft a private offer with a tiered discount ladder, ramp credit in escrow, pulse-floor that phases, HW co-marketing credit on milestones, renewal accelerator at >=95% utilization, PLG safety valve, and 12mo renewal price protection. next sync Thurs 9am PT.
Oliver (solutions): I'll be there.
Mike S (sales): adding to calendar.
Priya (finance): thanks — will share draft.
Ana (partnerships): thanks all :pray:
